fields.rationale: States cluster around whether they emphasize (1) simply matching standards with no extra hurdles, (2) requiring years of active practice, (3) explicitly requiring the other state to grant reciprocal privileges back, (4) demanding a full credential package including national exam and training, or (5) deferring broadly to an endorsement or portability framework with minimal extra conditions.
